page 1 · school

I was the quiet kid at the back of the class.

My marks were average, and so was my confidence. Many times I knew the answer, but I didn't raise my hand. I didn't think my voice mattered.

Who knows the answer?
↑ that's me, in the back. Tap her.
page 2 · the turning point

Then I found TED talks.

One talk became many. I watched normal people stand on a stage and talk about fear, failure and starting again.

Slowly, something changed inside me. I stopped waiting to feel confident. I started practising it, a little every day.

I can do this.
Slide it up. This is pretty much what happened to me.
page 3 · before graduation

So I started trying hard things.

Nobody made me do any of these. I just wanted to get better at something, and then at the next thing.

Classical Indian dance

I trained in classical dance. On a stage there's nowhere to hide. That's exactly why it was good for me.

Ukulele

I taught myself. No teacher, no classes. Just videos, sore fingers and many wrong notes.

Running

0 / 100 m

I started running in college. I came 3rd in the 100m sprint at our sports meet in 2024. Now I run 5 km.

3100m sprint, 2024
page 4 · 2024 · my first job

My first job: getting strangers to say yes.

For 6 months I worked in marketing and business development at Bold Ink Solutions. My job was to find the right companies, message them, and get them on a call with our founder.

Most people don't reply. That's normal. I kept going anyway.

page 6 · Oct 2026 – now

Now I make content for people on the other side of the world.

At Genplan, a startup in the US, I run social media on Instagram, Facebook, X and TikTok. I work directly with the founder.

Here's the fun part: our audience is Americans aged 60 and above. I'm a student in Jabalpur. I can't just guess what they like. So I research, I test, and I let the numbers tell me what's working.
